environment.description: ECS Fargate task with task role arn:iam::111122223333:role/StreamProcessorRole-Prod. IAM policy uses dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition to restrict GetItem/UpdateItem to items where PK begins with the caller's tagged tenant prefix (aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_prefix). The task role has a tag tenant_prefix=TENANT#svc-internal. Additionally, the DynamoDB table has a resource policy with a Deny statement for any principal whose aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_prefix does not match the leading key pattern in dynamodb:LeadingKeys. Kafka topic ACL restricts WRITE to producer service account only (principal=User:etl-producer-svc). Container runs with a custom seccomp profile that blocks execve, execveat, and fork syscalls (allowlist mode with 87 permitted syscalls excluding exec-family).

config.dynamodb_resource_policy: Deny if aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_prefix != leading key prefix
config.kafka_acl: ALLOW principal=User:etl-producer-svc operation=WRITE topic=transform-events; DENY principal=* operation=WRITE topic=transform-events
config.seccomp_profile: custom-allowlist-no-exec.json (87 syscalls, excludes execve/execveat/fork/vfork/clone for new processes)
